summary: Master cost accounting with our comprehensive training course. Gain practical skills and techniques to effectively manage and analyze financial data.
lede: Cost accounting techniques help finance and operations professionals classify costs and explain how overhead and cost behaviour shape product and service costs. They support practical work in allocating overhead, selecting activity-based cost drivers, analysing standard cost variances and calculating break-even points for pricing and budget decisions. Participants also develop cost models and management reports using spreadsheet and ERP cost data.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance and operations professionals who need practical cost visibility, cost control, and reliable management reporting.
audience: Operations Manager using cost reports to control
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: basic bookkeeping or financial accounting knowledge, comfort with spreadsheets, and a working understanding of profit and loss statements and cost terminology. No programming is required. Participants should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software available for calculations and templates.
